result.summary: Several layout overflow issues: restaurant names and the last category chip are clipped, and the bottom promo card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in Fastest near you (Trattoria Piccol) is clipped on the right, cutting off the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the horizontal list to scroll fully or add padding so names and images are not truncated at the screen edge.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant promo card is cut off by the tab bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so cards sit fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The category chips row is cut off on the right (Healthy is clipped, next chip barely visible).
issues.suggestion: Ensure the chips scroller has enough end padding or a fade so the last items are fully readable.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated and may be incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Use wrapping, smaller type, or ellipsis with a full name on a second line or tooltip.
